plr090.finding: a visible stack whose instances are all switched off is scanned to its end before being refused past the 1024 ceiling (src/effects.rs, the scan loop of map_stack)
plr090.disposition: NOT_CHANGED: refusal is already immediate wherever it is provably identical: a stack that cannot count (hidden layer or group, master switch off) is refused at the first instance past the ceiling. For a visible enabled stack a later instance can still be live, and then the outcome differs: the same 1025 switched-off instances are refused when nothing follows and mapped (CountedOnlyStack(1), dropped=1025) when one live instance follows. Stopping the scan would need knowledge of the instances not yet scanned (an enabled flag alone is not enough: the instance must also map). Work stays bounded by the descriptor reader caps (512 entries per list, 8192 items per descriptor)
